### The Greatness of God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/greatness-of-god
Passage: 1 Chronicles 16:25-26
Points:
- Unlike the lifeless idols worshipped across the ancient world, Yahweh alone made the heavens.
- God's supreme majesty and deeds are meant to be proclaimed among all peoples.
- The global scope of the Great Commission fulfills God's enduring desire for universal worship.
- True worship requires approaching the Lord with reverent trembling, joy, and thanksgiving.
